summary: Generated ten NinjaOne City R2 concepts with built-in image generation using the authored prompt set and the listed R1 structural/style reference, copied the selected outputs into city-ninjaone-r2 without deleting the generated originals, normalized all ten to exact 1536x1024 RGB grayscale through the repo-installed sharp fallback, built and visually inspected the contact sheet, and received a Director pass on the accepted set.

used.name: imagegen
used.why: Generated each of the ten distinct raster concepts through one built-in referenced-image call per authored prompt and preserved the generated originals.

used.name: task-packet-execution
used.why: Enforced the allowed write fence, stop conditions, gates, structured report shape, deviation logging, and handoff metadata.

generation.prompt_transform: Each authored prompt was used verbatim with one prepended role line: Image 1 role: structural and world-style reference only, not an edit target.

gates_run.summary: The prescribed command made no changes because python is not installed on PATH.
gates_run.failure_block: python : The term 'python' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program.

gates_run.summary: The Windows py launcher exists but has no installed Python runtime; no files changed.
Normalized 10/10 PNGs through the repo-installed sharp dependency.
Not repeated after the same missing-python condition was established by the prescribed normalization command; the equivalent sharp fallback was used.
Built the required two-column contact sheet containing all ten finals.
Contact sheet was visually inspected; Director explicitly passed it and ordered no further visual changes.
Verified exact prompt-set filename equality plus 1536x1024, three RGB channels, and exact per-pixel grayscale for all 10/10 PNGs.

claims.claim: Exactly ten final PNGs exist and their filenames equal the ten output values in prompt-set.json.
claims.evidence: Final verification reported verified 10/10 expected PNGs after an exact sorted-name comparison.

claims.claim: Every final PNG is exactly 1536x1024 with three RGB channels and exact R=G=B pixels.
claims.evidence: The final raw-pixel verification passed for all ten named PNGs.

claims.claim: All ten concepts were generated with the built-in image generator using the listed R1 reference as structural and world-style guidance.
claims.evidence: Ten separate built-in generation calls used the corresponding authored prompt verbatim plus the explicit reference-role line.

claims.claim: The accepted contact sheet contains the ten single-capital isometric concepts and received Director visual approval with no further visual changes requested.
claims.evidence: The sheet was loaded at original detail and the Director response was: Director contact-sheet review passes.

claims.claim: No exact NinjaOne logo or wordmark is reproduced in the accepted set.
claims.evidence: Visual inspection shows monochrome architectural identity cues and abstract device holograms rather than an exact corporate logo or wordmark; Director approved the sheet.
The ten selected built-in outputs were copied into the workspace; no delete operation was issued against the generated-images directory.

deviations.expected: Run both listed Python/Pillow gate commands.
deviations.actual: The normalization command failed because python was absent, and py -3 confirmed no installed runtime. Equivalent normalization, contact-sheet construction, and exact verification were run with the repo-installed sharp dependency from an allowed artifact script.
deviations.reason: No usable Python/Pillow runtime exists in the environment.
deviations.impact: The prescribed interpreter was unavailable, but the required artifacts and exact filename/dimension/RGB/grayscale acceptance properties were independently verified.

deviations.expected: Regenerate only material contact-sheet failures, with at most two targeted attempts.
deviations.actual: A stricter local review queued a targeted regeneration batch for concepts 03, 05, and 09. The Director then passed the existing contact sheet and explicitly ordered no further visual changes, so the in-flight batch was terminated and none of its outputs were copied.
deviations.reason: Latest explicit Director acceptance superseded the worker's stricter local visual concerns.
deviations.impact: The Director-approved ten-image set remained unchanged; zero regeneration outputs entered the workspace.

deviations.expected: The generic task-packet skill recommends one commit per green packet.
deviations.actual: No files were staged, committed, or pushed.
deviations.reason: The Director task packet explicitly prohibited commit, stage, and push operations.
deviations.impact: None; the packet artifacts and report are present in the shared worktree for Director integration.
